title: Great gift
text: Great gift. Good quality little light. Nice little cloth and foam gift box. This is the second of these I have purchased as a gift. This one was a gift for my dad who lives in a different state. I told him that where ever in the universe he may be, just look at the stars and think of me. It made him cry and he turns it on every night and falls asleep thinking of me. Not too big or bright. Just the right size.
